SoftwarePage.leadText: Energy Management Software is a web-oriented software that is an indispensable tool in the work of an energy manager.
SoftwarePage.targetText: The software is primarily intended for municipalities, public utility companies, but can also be used by other interested companies that want to monitor their energy consumption and performance.

capabilitiesList: Storage and access to information on energy and water consumption in all facilities covered by the system.
Continuous updating and maintenance of database on individual facilities
Continuous entry and monitoring of consumption data for all types of energy sources and water
Processing and analysis of collected data
Early detection of unnecessary energy waste
Creating an information basis for decision making
Review and analysis of historical operational data
Identification, preparation and execution of energy efficiency improvement projects
Precise definition of consumption, efficiency and performance indicators

EnergyManagementPage.leadText: Eneplus performs an energy management service that represents the process of managing the energy performance of a municipality, company or specific facility, and includes an analysis of the current state, the process of procurement and energy production until its final use.
EnergyManagementPage.p1: System power management is ensuring continuous care about the efficiency of energy and water consumption, and hence concerns about the environment.
EnergyManagementPage.p2: Only technical measures without the establishment of energy management are not sufficient to achieve the estimated savings. Energy efficiency or energy improvements are a combination of technology-related and human-factor measures.
EnergyManagementPage.p3: Establishing and introducing an energy management system also involves the implementation of education activities and raising awareness of users on the importance of rational use of energy. Such activities provide long-term continuity and effectiveness of energy efficiency programs.
EnergyManagementPage.isoSubtitle: The energy management cycle according to the ISO 50001 standard implies the implementation of the following activities:
isoSteps: Defining the company's energy policy in accordance with its activities and energy saving needs
Energy planning that involves the development of an action plan for energy savings (based on the previous energy audit)
Implementing an energy saving plan through examined and approved projects
Control of the realization of the energy saving plan
Monitoring the effect of the implemented measures
Application of corrective measures in relation to nonconformities and deviations from the plans
Conducting internal audits that verify that the energy management system is well established and in place

CertificationPage.passportText2: Energy passports must have all new buildings, as well as existing buildings that are being reconstructed, adapted, renovated or sanitized, except buildings that are exempted from the requirement of energy certification.

IsoPage.leadText: The purpose of this international standard is to enable organizations to establish the systems and processes needed to improve energy performance, including energy efficiency, use and energy consumption.
IsoPage.navPurpose: The purpose of this standard is to reduce energy costs, greenhouse gas emissions and other negative impacts on the environment through systematic energy management.
IsoPage.introText: This international standard can be applied to all types and sizes of organizations, regardless of geographical, cultural or social conditions. Successful implementation depends on commitment from all levels and functions of the organization, and especially from top management.
IsoPage.benefitsSubtitle: Companies with an energy management system in accordance with the ISO 50001 standard open up new business opportunities for themselves. There are more and more global companies in the world wanting to do business with partners that have introduced the ISO 50001 standard.
directBenefitsList: Harmonization of energy consumption with the legal provisions
businessBenefitsList: Credibility in world frames on the need for rational energy management
Translation of energy management into business practice
Improving corporate image among regulatory bodies, clients and the public
Monitoring parameters through consistent Plan - Do - Check - Act method
IsoPage.implText: Introducing the ISO 50001 standard is imperative for all companies that want to improve and strengthen their market position against the competition.
IsoPage.consultingBold: Eneplus provides consulting services in the process of implementing energy management system.
IsoPage.consultingText: Our practical experience, participation in standard preparation committees, knowledge of procedures, required documents and available technologies will greatly facilitate the introduction of the ISO 50001 standard in your organization.
IsoPage.ctaText: Contact us for expert assistance in implementing ISO 50001.

EnergyAuditsPage.introText: An energy audit is an inspection, survey and analysis of energy flows, for energy conservation in a building, process or system to reduce the amount of energy input into the system without negatively affecting the output(s).
EnergyAuditsPage.detailsText1: It is the first step in identifying opportunities to reduce energy expense and carbon footprints. It is an efficient tool that gives a clear insight into the condition of power installations, equipment and also the constructive characteristics of the facility that have a significant impact on energy consumption. The aim of the energy audit is to determine the location and causes of irrational energy consumption.
EnergyAuditsPage.detailsText2: By eliminating these causes, we achieve not only energy savings, but also savings in the budget, as well as extending the life of equipment and installations.
EnergyAuditsPage.strategyText: An energy audit is a systematic approach to reviewing the existing energy performance of a system or object, including an analysis of measures to improve its energy efficiency. Energy efficiency becomes a factor of success and the competitive advantage of companies, as energy is the basis of prosperity and economic development.
EnergyAuditsPage.servicesSubtitle: Within the energy audits carried out according to the standards <highlight>ISO 50002</highlight> and <highlight>EN 16247</highlight> ENEPLUS offers the following services:
servicesList: Gathering data on energy consumption and distribution by consumers
Preparation of a priority list of energy efficiency measures
Advising on the establishment of an energy management system
benefitsList: Improvement of the company / institution image
EnergyAuditsPage.ctaText: Reduce costs and optimize energy consumption.

MeasurementsPage.thermoLead: Infrared thermography is a method of contactless temperature measurement and its distribution on the surface of the observed object.
MeasurementsPage.thermoText: The application of thermography in the building provides great possibilities for controlling the quality of works in new buildings, as well as assessing the current state of the older buildings. In addition to providing an insight into the state of the object in terms of thermal insulation of the building, infrared thermography can be successfully applied to assess the condition of the building envelope:
thermoList: detection of different types of errors (defects and damage)
the detection of the separation of the mortar from the surface and the possible presence of air or moisture into the layers below the outer plasters, and for evaluation of flat roofs
detection of the location of the separation of the roofing board from the substrate, inspection of electrical and HVAC installations, inspection of devices and equipment, etc …
MeasurementsPage.blowerSubtitle: Checking the air-tightness of the building
MeasurementsPage.preventionText: The Blower Door measurement makes it possible to check the air-tightness of the building. It can prevent the formation of structural damage caused by the penetration of warm and humid air into the structure of the object through the joints.
MeasurementsPage.comfortText: In addition, the level of comfort in the object is also eliminated by the removal of the draft and the entry of cold air.
MeasurementsPage.standardsText: When reconstructing an existing facility, the air barrier, if it is planned in accordance with recognized standards, can meet applicable standards for a low-energy facility or passive house.
MeasurementsPage.comfortCheckLead: Checking the conditions of comfort in buildings (temperature, CO2, humidity, lighting ...)
MeasurementsPage.ctaText: Contact us for precise measurements and analysis of your building.
